messages:
tom_sales: Passing to CS 10CloudOps signed pilot today. They want Dedicated (2xA100) w/ VPC peering in eu-west-1 and SAML SSO. Exec sponsor: Matteo Rossi (Head of AI). Pilot target: 2024-06-10. Key risks: SSO cert rotation, EU audit log export, and model hallucination on financial jargon. Adding @priya_cs and @nina_eng as owners. :tada:

priya_cs: I can take ownership. I'll run kickoff and weekly check-ins. Tom, please add legal/billing contacts and the prompt set. We also need customer's network team contact for peering.

jared_csm: Day-to-day CSM here. Can we confirm model pin and whether they want nightly evals against labeled samples? Also need SLA expectations for pilot.

tom_sales: Model pin: redwood-v2-13b-quant. Billing: billing@10cloudops.com, Legal: legal@10cloudops.com. They requested audit logs to be exported to their EU S3. I'll upload the prompt set to shared folder today. SLA ask: 99.5% during pilot.

infra_bot: Tickets created: CS-7988 "10CloudOps EU peering info needed" and ENG-6765 "10CloudOps SAML cert rotation investigation" - https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-7988 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-6765

nina_eng: I'll triage ENG-6765. Need SAML metadata XML, SP entity ID, and cert expiry date. For peering: need allowed CIDRs and whether they require private routing. ETA 48h for initial triage.

priya_cs: Enablement ask: Eng to join 20m slot in kickoff for SSO + prompt engineering tips? Also CSM will collect 50 labeled examples for nightly evals. @nina_eng @jared_csm

nina_eng: I can join kickoff. Note: recommend prefix caching for recurring system prompts and auto-fallback to redwood-v1-7b if pool exhausted. I'll add checklist items to ENG ticket.

priya_cs: Action summary: 1) Tom to upload prompt set + legal/billing contacts (DONE) 2) Infra_bot tickets active 3) Nina to triage SAML/peering (ETA 48h) 4) Jared to schedule kickoff week of 6/3 and own trial feedback capture 5) Priya to track weekly status and flag renewal risk if pilot metrics < targets. Any additions? :eyes:
